name: Notifications
description: Lands in queue q.aem.events (subscription aem/notifications/* - exactly one level)

name: ACL checks
description: Run against all local-docker brokers to compare the users - see the test descriptions for the expected result per broker

name: Order created
description: Persistent order event with user properties and a local variable - lands in q.aem.orders

name: Order cancelled
description: High priority persistent order event - lands in q.aem.orders

name: Inventory updated
description: Persistent message with random values and TTL - lands in q.aem.events

name: Shipment dispatched
description: Persistent event with a carrier user property - lands in q.aem.events

name: Email notification
description: One level below aem/notifications/ - matches aem/notifications/* and lands in q.aem.events

name: Notification too deep
description: Two levels below aem/notifications/ - PASSED (the broker acks it) but NOT queued because * matches only one level

name: Publish below aem/
description: Expected: PASSED on local-docker and local-docker (publisher) - FAILED (Publish ACL Denied) on local-docker (subscriber)

name: Publish outside aem/
description: Expected: PASSED on local-docker only - FAILED (Publish ACL Denied) on local-docker (publisher) and local-docker (subscriber)

name: Ping
description: Direct message - passes when sent (not queued)
